name: Shioya (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Shioya town emblem in white: a winged device above a ring enclosing a drop-shaped notch.
history: Municipal flag of Shioya, a town in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 6 June 1978.

features.role: Shioya town emblem — a winged device above a ring enclosing a drop-shaped notch
